message.jaymoskingdoms.needs_axe: Wood needs an axe. Knap flint on stone into shards, cut grass with a primitive knife for fiber, twist it into plant string, and bind a flint hatchet.
message.jaymoskingdoms.trunk_built_on: Something's built on this trunk. It stays where it is.
message.jaymoskingdoms.trunk_too_heavy: Too heavy to shift on your own.
message.jaymoskingdoms.avatar.silent: The avatar's eyes burn past you. It has no words for anyone who isn't Emberborn.
message.jaymoskingdoms.avatar.welcome.0: Your blood runs hot, kin. %s has room at its fire. Come, speak with us.
message.jaymoskingdoms.avatar.welcome.1: One of ours, out here alone? Come in to %s and sit by the hearth.
message.jaymoskingdoms.avatar.welcome.2: The fire knew you before we did. %s is yours as much as ours.
message.jaymoskingdoms.avatar.gift.0: You came with empty hands. Take these, you'll want them.
message.jaymoskingdoms.avatar.gift.1: Flint, sticks, a little string, food. Enough for a start.
message.jaymoskingdoms.avatar.gift.2: Here. Nobody of ours walks the ash with nothing.
message.jaymoskingdoms.omen.seen: The people of %s see the omen on you. Whatever good name you had here is gone: you've brought a raid to their door.
message.jaymoskingdoms.omen.grudge: %s survived the raid you brought. They will almost never forget it.
message.jaymoskingdoms.omen.forgiven: After all this time, %s has finally let go of its grudge against you.
message.jaymoskingdoms.moon.blood: The Blood Moon rises. The dead stir thick and strong tonight, and no one will sleep.
message.jaymoskingdoms.moon.super_blood: A Super Blood Moon fills the sky. Bar the doors: tonight the dark empties itself onto you.
message.jaymoskingdoms.moon.harvest: The Harvest Moon rises, gold and heavy. Fields and orchards ripen through the night.
message.jaymoskingdoms.moon.blue: A Blue Moon rises. Fortune favours those out under it tonight.
message.jaymoskingdoms.moon.no_sleep: You can't sleep under the Blood Moon.
message.jaymoskingdoms.reputation.hostil: %s now counts you an enemy. Its guards will attack you on sight.
message.jaymoskingdoms.reputation.forgiv: %s no longer counts you an enemy.
message.jaymoskingdoms.audience: The court of %s regards you as %s (%s).
message.jaymoskingdoms.left: You have renounced %s. It won't forget it.
message.jaymoskingdoms.deposited: You give %s to the treasury of %s (now %s).
message.jaymoskingdoms.withdrew: You draw %s from the treasury of %s.
message.jaymoskingdoms.none: No kingdoms or villages yet: find a village.
message.jaymoskingdoms.already_sworn: You are already sworn to a kingdom. Leave it first.
message.jaymoskingdoms.not_sworn: You aren't sworn to any kingdom.
message.jaymoskingdoms.not_welcome: %s won't take your pledge: earn its trust first.
message.jaymoskingdoms.lords_only: Only a lord of the kingdom may draw on its treasury.
message.jaymoskingdoms.king_rallies: %s rallies! His guards rush to his side.
message.jaymoskingdoms.king_fallen: The King of %s has fallen to %s!
message.jaymoskingdoms.old_age.king: The King of %s has died peacefully in his sleep, at a great age. His heir will take the throne by tomorrow.
message.jaymoskingdoms.old_age.lord: The Lord of %s has died peacefully in his sleep, at a great age. His heir will take the seat by tomorrow.
message.jaymoskingdoms.fate.successor: %s mourns its king. An heir will take the throne by tomorrow.
message.jaymoskingdoms.fate.vassal: %s bends the knee: it is now a fiefdom of %s, and a lord will rule it.
message.jaymoskingdoms.fate.ruin: %s falls into ruin. Its people scatter.
message.jaymoskingdoms.succession: A new king takes the throne of %s.
message.jaymoskingdoms.build.rebuilding: %1$s's builders begin to put up the %2$s again
message.jaymoskingdoms.king_demoted: %s sets aside his crown: he is %s now, sworn to %s.
message.jaymoskingdoms.audience.fief: %s is a fiefdom: its ruler holds it for %s and pays tribute.
message.jaymoskingdoms.info.storage_unlo: Its storehouse is too far away to take stock of.
message.jaymoskingdoms.info.economy: Economy: %s of %s food in stock; short for its next building: %s; %s free slots
message.jaymoskingdoms.info.personnel: Personnel: %s of %s needed (%s to replace); %s villagers, a crew of %s builders
message.jaymoskingdoms.no_pledge: %s takes no pledges: only kingdoms, fiefdoms and the greenskin kingdoms do.
message.jaymoskingdoms.elder_died: The elder of %s is dead. The village mourns.
message.jaymoskingdoms.lord_fallen: The Lord of %s has fallen to %s!
message.jaymoskingdoms.fate.successor_lo: %s mourns its lord. Another will take his seat by tomorrow.
message.jaymoskingdoms.succession.lord: A new lord takes the seat of %s.
message.jaymoskingdoms.barbarian.spared: %s lets you be: an outlaw to the realm nearby is welcome here. Kill their own and the welcome won't last.
message.jaymoskingdoms.barbarian.disguis: %s takes you for one of its own. Don't strike any of them.
message.jaymoskingdoms.raid.announce: War horns! A war party from %s marches on %s!
message.jaymoskingdoms.raid.beaten: The war party of %s is beaten off.
message.jaymoskingdoms.raid.withdraw: The war party of %s withdraws with its plunder.
message.jaymoskingdoms.camp.cleared: The chief of %s has fallen to %s! The camp scatters.
message.jaymoskingdoms.camp.thanks: Word of the chief's death spreads: every kingdom and village thinks better of you.
message.jaymoskingdoms.build.finished: The builders of %s have finished a %s.
message.jaymoskingdoms.plot.not_land: Plots can only be marked in a kingdom's or village's land.
message.jaymoskingdoms.plot.lords_only: Only a lord of %s may mark its plots.
message.jaymoskingdoms.plot.outside: That plot would reach outside the land of %s.

message.jaymoskingdoms.plot.none_here: You aren't standing on a plot.
message.jaymoskingdoms.plot.unknown: The builders don't know how to build a %s.
message.jaymoskingdoms.plot.busy: The builders are already at work on plot %s.
message.jaymoskingdoms.plot.chosen: Plot %s: the builders will put up a %s when they can.

message.jaymoskingdoms.design.too_many_b: That has more than %s blocks: too much for builders.
message.jaymoskingdoms.design.failed: The design %s couldn't be saved or deleted (see the server log).

message.jaymoskingdoms.design.not_yours: The design %s isn't yours to delete.
message.jaymoskingdoms.design.no_selecti: Mark two corners with a surveyor's rod in Design mode first.
message.jaymoskingdoms.design.none: Nobody has saved a design yet.
message.jaymoskingdoms.design.line_bad: %s: can't be read or too big for builders

message.jaymoskingdoms.plan_site.built: %s is built! (%s of its %s blocks in place)

message.jaymoskingdoms.mason_table.too_f: That plan is laid out too far away: the table builds within %s blocks.

message.jaymoskingdoms.mason_table.retry: Trying the %s blocks that were in the way again.

message.jaymoskingdoms.commission.nowher: Stand in a settlement to give it plans.
message.jaymoskingdoms.commission.strang: %s only takes plans from its own people and good friends.
message.jaymoskingdoms.commission.no_bui: %s has no builders to put it up.
message.jaymoskingdoms.commission.yours_: %s is still to build the plans you gave it.
message.jaymoskingdoms.commission.taken: The steward takes your plans for %s. %s's builders will put it up (%s x %s, %s high) on open ground when they're free and the storage holds the materials.
message.jaymoskingdoms.commission.built: %s, from your plans, stands finished in %s.
message.jaymoskingdoms.commission.withdr: Took back your plans for %s from %s.
message.jaymoskingdoms.area.overlap: That would overlap the %s already there.
message.jaymoskingdoms.area.field_size: A field of %s x %s won't do: each side must be %s to %s blocks.

message.jaymoskingdoms.area.farmer_hired: %s takes on a farmer for it.
message.jaymoskingdoms.area.quarry_size: A quarry of %s x %s won't do: each side must be %s to %s blocks.
message.jaymoskingdoms.area.quarry_marke: Quarry marked (%s x %s, %s deep). The miners of %s will dig it out, leaving a stair along its north side.
message.jaymoskingdoms.area.miner_hired: %s takes on a miner for it.
message.jaymoskingdoms.area.not_containe: That isn't a chest or a barrel.
message.jaymoskingdoms.area.storage_keep: %s's workers need that one: it's where they load.
message.jaymoskingdoms.area.none_here: You aren't standing in a field or quarry.
message.jaymoskingdoms.project.nothing: nothing (the town has all it needs for its size)
message.jaymoskingdoms.chat.unheard: No one is near enough to hear you.
message.jaymoskingdoms.pickpocket.caught: %s turns round and catches your hand in their pocket!
message.jaymoskingdoms.pickpocket.liftin: Your hand's in %s's pocket... [%s] keep holding, stay behind them
message.jaymoskingdoms.skills.level: Your %s rises to level %s. Press K to spend the point.
message.jaymoskingdoms.skills.milestone: Milestone! Your %s reaches level %s: a bonus point on top of the usual one. Press K to spend them.
message.jaymoskingdoms.manacles.not_thei: The watch only takes in raiders and looters, not chiefs, captains or rulers.
message.jaymoskingdoms.manacles.up: They have to be down before you can put manacles on them.
message.jaymoskingdoms.manacles.no_law: There is no realm here to hand them to.
message.jaymoskingdoms.manacles.led: A guard of %s takes the prisoner to be judged.
message.jaymoskingdoms.manacles.taken: A guard of %s takes the prisoner away to the cells.
message.jaymoskingdoms.lock.no_pick.pin: Locked: a %s pin lock. You'll need a lockpick.
message.jaymoskingdoms.lock.no_pick.rota: Locked: a %s rotary lock. You'll need a lockpick.
message.jaymoskingdoms.combat_art.none: Learn Charge, War Cry or Shield Throw in the Strength tree (K, Combat Arts) to use this key.
message.jaymoskingdoms.skills.night: You lived through the night. (+%s Survival)
message.jaymoskingdoms.skills.last_stand: Last Stand! You cling on with half a heart.
message.jaymoskingdoms.downed.nothing: There's nothing left in their hands to take.
message.jaymoskingdoms.skills.respec.bot: You drink the bottle o' enchanting. What you'd learned slips away; your points are yours to spend again.
message.jaymoskingdoms.skills.respec.wiz: The wizard's spell unmakes what you'd learned. Your points are yours to spend again.
message.jaymoskingdoms.retaliation.start: They hit back! Stop swinging and they'll cool off, or pay them off: use one with coins or a purse in hand.
message.jaymoskingdoms.retaliation.price: They want %s in your hand to let it go.
message.jaymoskingdoms.retaliation.paid: You paid %s. That one lets it go.
message.jaymoskingdoms.retaliation.paid_: You paid off the one you struck. The rest let it go too.
message.jaymoskingdoms.retaliation.downe: You're down. They leave you lying there.
message.jaymoskingdoms.retaliation.coole: They've cooled off and go back about their day.
message.jaymoskingdoms.retaliation.squar: You want a fight? You've got one!
Hit me, will you? Come here!
That's it. Help! Someone help me sort this one out!
Please, I've done nothing to you!
...Fine. We'll call it even. This time.
Hm. That'll buy some bandages. Get out of my sight.
I'll take your coin. I won't forget your fist.
message.jaymoskingdoms.retaliation.refus: You think silver washes that off? Never.
Not for all the silver in the realm.
message.jaymoskingdoms.creed.rivals: %s (%s) and %s (%s) can no longer abide each other: they are rivals now.
message.jaymoskingdoms.creed.inevitable: It has come to this: %s, sworn to %s, will not suffer %s and its %s any longer.
message.jaymoskingdoms.creed.tensions: Tension between realms (war at the second number):
message.jaymoskingdoms.creed.no_tension: No realms are at odds yet.
message.jaymoskingdoms.creed.unknown: No such creed: crown, chivalry, conquest, faith, coin or blood.
message.jaymoskingdoms.creed.not_yours: Only the lords of a free players' realm at peace may choose its creed.

message.jaymoskingdoms.illager_camp.than: Word of the warlord's death spreads: every kingdom and village thinks better of you.

message.jaymoskingdoms.free_rein.off: Free rein off: your horse follows the camera again
message.jaymoskingdoms.horse_comes: %s trusts you now: it will come when you whistle.
message.jaymoskingdoms.already_shod: Those shoes still have plenty of wear in them.
message.jaymoskingdoms.too_heavy: %s won't kneel for a rider in armour that heavy yet.
message.jaymoskingdoms.brushed: You brush %s until its coat shines (trust %s).
message.jaymoskingdoms.whistle_shy: Your horses don't trust you enough to come to a whistle yet.
message.jaymoskingdoms.whistle_none: No horse of yours hears the whistle.
message.jaymoskingdoms.trick_slide_locke: A sliding stop needs racing level %s.
message.jaymoskingdoms.trick_needs_bridl: A sliding stop needs a bridle.
message.jaymoskingdoms.trick_kick_locked: The war kick needs war level %s.
message.jaymoskingdoms.trick_rear_locked: Rearing on command needs level %s in any discipline.
message.jaymoskingdoms.racing_throw: A bad landing pitches you out of the racing saddle!
message.jaymoskingdoms.lame: %s is going lame: pick its hooves or have it shod.
message.jaymoskingdoms.raid.announce.orc: Drums in the hills! The orcs of %s march on %s!
message.jaymoskingdoms.orc_camp.cleared: The warchief of %s has fallen to %s! The orcs break and flee.
message.jaymoskingdoms.orc_camp.thanks: Word of the warchief's death spreads: every kingdom and village thinks better of you.
message.jaymoskingdoms.orc.new_chief: %s beat %s in the challenge and is warchief of %s now.
message.jaymoskingdoms.slave.chained: Its chain is too thick for bare hands. Try shears, an axe or a pickaxe.
message.jaymoskingdoms.slave.freed: You break the goblin's chain. The goblins will hear of it.
message.jaymoskingdoms.giant.rises: The monolith hums awake. The %s rises from the earth!
message.jaymoskingdoms.giant.grabbed: The %s has you in its grip!
message.jaymoskingdoms.monolith.needs_ti: The monolith's stone won't give. Only a high-tier Tinkers tool (diamond-tier or better) can break it.
message.jaymoskingdoms.giant.first_falle: The %s has fallen. Across the world the Aether's last remnants stir, and the world grows harsher: no one plays below %s now.
message.jaymoskingdoms.mythic_mount.nigh: Hoofbeats, and a smell of smoke. A horse made of night and embers is watching you.
message.jaymoskingdoms.mythic_mount.bat_: Leathery wings beat in the dark. A horse is coming down out of the trees.
message.jaymoskingdoms.grave.read: Here lies %s. Laid to rest on day %s.
message.jaymoskingdoms.grave.read_of: Here lies %s, of %s. Laid to rest on day %s.
message.jaymoskingdoms.bury.rite.2: There. Nothing more can hurt you now, %s.
message.jaymoskingdoms.bury.thanks.0: Thank you for bringing them home.
message.jaymoskingdoms.bury.thanks.1: Kind of you to carry them. Not many would.
message.jaymoskingdoms.bury.thanks.2: You've done right by the dead. We won't forget it.
message.jaymoskingdoms.mourn.partner.0: %s... how am I to go on without you?
message.jaymoskingdoms.mourn.kin.2: Sleep now, %s. We'll look after each other.
message.jaymoskingdoms.mourn.friend.1: The square won't be the same without you, %s.
message.jaymoskingdoms.mourn.comrade.0: Stood your ground to the last, %s.
message.jaymoskingdoms.mourn.comrade.2: We'll hold the line for you, %s.
message.jaymoskingdoms.mourn.visit.1: The house is so quiet now, %s.
message.jaymoskingdoms.mourn.visit.2: I still talk to you, %s. Every day.
message.jaymoskingdoms.class.reborn: The writ crumbles. What you were falls away; choose again.
message.jaymoskingdoms.spell.learned: You learn %s. Sneak and use your staff to turn to it.
message.jaymoskingdoms.spell.only: Your staff knows only %s. Read scrolls to learn more.
message.jaymoskingdoms.imbue.no_blade: Hold a blade to imbue it.
message.jaymoskingdoms.storm.step_wait: The bolt is still gathering: %s s.
message.jaymoskingdoms.storm.step_blocke: No room to step that way.
message.jaymoskingdoms.storm.ring_wait: The storm is still gathering: %s s.
message.jaymoskingdoms.imbue.faded: The element fades from your blade.
message.jaymoskingdoms.imbue.moved: This blade burns with %s now; your last one goes cold.
message.jaymoskingdoms.scroll_beyond: This scroll is beyond a Sorcerer's quick magic.
message.jaymoskingdoms.class.mage_staff: A wizard's staff casts in a Mage's hands. Sneak and speak to a court wizard to learn how one is made, or find one.
message.jaymoskingdoms.class.staff_recip: You learn how a wizard's staff is made: gold and amethyst on two blaze rods. It's in your recipe book.
message.jaymoskingdoms.alien.seen: The people of %s saw you change. They know the alien is you.
message.jaymoskingdoms.symbiote.seen: The people of %s saw the symbiote come over you. They know the black thing is you.
message.jaymoskingdoms.shade.seen: The people of %s saw you rise as your shadow. They know the shade is you.
message.jaymoskingdoms.handshake.not_tod: They already turned your hand down today.
message.jaymoskingdoms.handshake.ruler: Rulers don't shake hands. Seek an audience instead.
message.jaymoskingdoms.handshake.village: They shake your hand and tell you their name: %s.
message.jaymoskingdoms.greet.waved: They give you a wave instead.
message.jaymoskingdoms.greet.came_offer: They hold out a hand to you. Use on them to shake it.
message.jaymoskingdoms.greet.came_waved: They wave and tell you their name: %s.
message.jaymoskingdoms.greet.came_waved_: They wave, tap their chest and say a name: %s.
message.jaymoskingdoms.handshake.wary: They step back from you. They want nothing to do with you yet.
message.jaymoskingdoms.bow.known: They incline their head. You know them now: %s.
message.jaymoskingdoms.bow.foreign: They incline their head and give a name: %s.
message.jaymoskingdoms.introduce.none: Look at the player you want to introduce yourself to.
message.jaymoskingdoms.introduce.masked: Not behind a mask: that would give your face away.
message.jaymoskingdoms.handshake.offered: You hold out your hand to %s.
message.jaymoskingdoms.handshake.offer: %s holds out a hand. Use on them to shake it.
message.jaymoskingdoms.group.none: You're in no party. Shake hands with someone to start one.
message.jaymoskingdoms.group.kept: This group is kept by the server.
message.jaymoskingdoms.succession.villag: %s, one of its own people, now rules %s.
message.jaymoskingdoms.ruler.steps_down: %s steps down from the throne of %s; %s, one of its own people, rules now.
message.jaymoskingdoms.frost_prison.wait: The frost in you needs time to gather again (about %s min).
message.jaymoskingdoms.frost_prison.none: Look at something living to lock it in ice.
message.jaymoskingdoms.frost_prison.big: That is too big to lock in ice.
message.jaymoskingdoms.vampire.turned: You wake with a thirst no water will touch. The light stings your eyes.
message.jaymoskingdoms.cure.done: The priest's prayer burns through you, and then it's gone. You're yourself again.
message.jaymoskingdoms.werewolf.ritual: The fires gutter. Something in the moonlight looks back at you.
message.jaymoskingdoms.werewolf.moon: The moon holds you. There's no changing back tonight.
message.jaymoskingdoms.werewolf.unmaster: The wolf won't come at your call. Not yet.
message.jaymoskingdoms.werewolf.wolfbloo: The fires gutter, but the moon isn't full. Only half the wolf comes into you.
message.jaymoskingdoms.werewolf.half: Your wolfblood can't change you. Only a full moon could finish the rite.
message.jaymoskingdoms.werewolf.den: You come to in the dark, curled in earth that smells of you.
message.jaymoskingdoms.vampire.turned_ha: You wake with a thirst, but the gold in your blood holds it back. Half of you is still yours.
message.jaymoskingdoms.vampire.crypt: You wake on cold stone in a crypt you've never seen. It feels like home.
message.jaymoskingdoms.vampire.gold: The gold burns going down. Something in your blood fights back.
message.jaymoskingdoms.warrior_zenkai: You came back from the brink stronger: ten attribute points are yours.
message.jaymoskingdoms.earthling_surge: Your ki flares on the brink: %s!
message.jaymoskingdoms.nightborn.fever: Your blood is racing toward something.
message.jaymoskingdoms.nightborn.old_blo: It came easily, as if your blood had only been waiting to be asked.
message.jaymoskingdoms.nightborn.born_dh: The gold held the thirst back. The night it couldn't hold back at all.
message.jaymoskingdoms.nightborn.trace_e: The rite is done, but the dark still opens to your eyes.
message.jaymoskingdoms.nightborn.trace_s: The rite is done, but something in your blood still listens for them.
message.jaymoskingdoms.nightkin.whisper: %s leans close, voice low: "The night is in you already, child of the dark. Let me finish what it began."
message.jaymoskingdoms.nightkin.accepted: The teeth are gentle. The cold that follows is not.
message.jaymoskingdoms.nightkin.refused: "Another night, then." He steps back into the dark.
message.jaymoskingdoms.nightkin.walked: You feel eyes on your back, but nothing follows.
message.jaymoskingdoms.nightkin.no_offer: No one is waiting on your answer.
message.jaymoskingdoms.bed_rest: You lie down to rest. Poison and withering can't hurt you here.
message.jaymoskingdoms.charter.overworld: Roads can only be charted in the Overworld
message.jaymoskingdoms.charter.begun: Charting from this sign. Follow your road to another sign and mark it with the charter (mark this one again to stop)
message.jaymoskingdoms.charter.not_here: Your chart doesn't reach this sign: follow the road right up to it
message.jaymoskingdoms.charter.short: Too short to chart: a road must run at least %s blocks
message.jaymoskingdoms.charter.off_road: Only %s%% of that was on road (paths, gravel, cobble, bricks, planks): it needs %s%%
message.jaymoskingdoms.charter.linked: Road charted: %s blocks. Right-click either sign to travel it
message.jaymoskingdoms.charter.put_away: You stopped charting (keep the charter in hand while you go)
message.jaymoskingdoms.charter.lost: Your chart lost the road: start again from a sign
message.jaymoskingdoms.milestone.coach_h: A coach drives you along the road at a gallop. The fare goes to the nearest realm
message.jaymoskingdoms.journey.turned_ba: You turn back and get down. Your %s silver are yours again.
You turn back and get down.
message.jaymoskingdoms.milestone.telepor: There after a moment's blackout, worn out as if you'd walked it. The fare is lost to the road
message.jaymoskingdoms.milestone.too_far: Stand by the milestone to travel from it
message.jaymoskingdoms.milestone.gone: The sign at the other end is gone, and the road with it
message.jaymoskingdoms.milestone.rest: You're still worn out from the last road: %s s
message.jaymoskingdoms.milestone.arrived: You travel the road to %s (%s blocks)
message.jaymoskingdoms.milestone.no_coac: No coachmen work these parts: there's no realm to send one
message.jaymoskingdoms.milestone.dismoun: Get down first: the coach can't take you mounted
message.jaymoskingdoms.milestone.coach_o: A coach takes you along the road to %s (%s silver)
message.jaymoskingdoms.ship.sunk.pirate: The pirate ship %s has gone down, sunk by %s!
message.jaymoskingdoms.ship.sunk.navy: The warship %s has gone down, sunk by %s.
message.jaymoskingdoms.ship.sunk.merchan: The merchantman %s has gone down, sunk by %s.
message.jaymoskingdoms.ship.sunk.whaler: The whaler %s has gone down, sunk by %s.
message.jaymoskingdoms.raid.announce.pir: Sails on the horizon! The pirates of %s are coming ashore at %s!
message.jaymoskingdoms.pirate_cove.clear: The pirate captain of %s has fallen to %s! The cove's pirates scatter.
message.jaymoskingdoms.pirate_cove.thank: Word of the captain's death spreads along the coast: every kingdom and village thinks better of you.
message.jaymoskingdoms.festival: Bells ring in %s: a festival today at the square! All are welcome.
message.jaymoskingdoms.festival_welcome: The folk of %s welcome you to their festival.
message.jaymoskingdoms.festival_lords: Only a lord of a realm, or its ruler, can call a festival.
message.jaymoskingdoms.festival_soon: Your realm held a festival lately; another can be called %s days after it.
message.jaymoskingdoms.festival_war: No festivals while the realm is at war.
message.jaymoskingdoms.festival_cost: A festival costs the treasury %s emeralds, and it hasn't got them.
message.jaymoskingdoms.festival_called_t: %s keeps a festival today (%s emeralds from the treasury).
message.jaymoskingdoms.festival_called: %s will keep a festival tomorrow (%s emeralds from the treasury).
message.jaymoskingdoms.courier_empty: Hold what you want delivered in your hand.
message.jaymoskingdoms.courier_far: They're too far away for anyone to take it to them.
message.jaymoskingdoms.courier_nobody: There's nobody about free to run an errand.
message.jaymoskingdoms.courier_refused: The folk of %s won't run errands for you.
message.jaymoskingdoms.heritage.unlocked: Something old stirs in your blood: %s. Your children may be born to it.
message.jaymoskingdoms.heritage.rite_cru: The rite crumbles to dust. Blood isn't changed by rites any more: it runs on in your children.
message.jaymoskingdoms.elder.set_off: %s has packed a bag and set off for %s, to see it again while the legs still carry them. Don't wait up.
message.jaymoskingdoms.elder.home: %s is home again from %s, tired and full of stories.
message.jaymoskingdoms.lineage.gone: Your child isn't by you any more. The moment passes.
message.jaymoskingdoms.lineage.lives_on: You open your eyes as your child, %2$s in your veins. %1$s lives on, grey now, and you will need a calling of your own.
message.jaymoskingdoms.sea_body.head: It won't fit over a head like yours.
message.jaymoskingdoms.sea_body.back: It won't fit over a back like yours.
message.jaymoskingdoms.variant.offer: Every heritage now comes in several looks. Which %s are you? (once, for life)
message.jaymoskingdoms.variant.settled: Your look was settled long ago.
message.jaymoskingdoms.variant.unknown: That isn't one of your heritage's looks.
message.jaymoskingdoms.identity.hostile: %1$s now counts %2$s an enemy. Its guards will attack that mask on sight.
message.jaymoskingdoms.identity.known.un: The people of %1$s saw you take off your mask. They know %2$s is you now, and whatever %2$s did there is yours.
message.jaymoskingdoms.identity.known.lo: The people of %1$s saw you lower your hood. They know %2$s is you now, and whatever %2$s did there is yours.
message.jaymoskingdoms.identity.known.ma: The people of %1$s saw you put on your mask. They know %2$s is you now, and whatever %2$s did there is yours.
message.jaymoskingdoms.identity.known.po: The people of %1$s have put two and two together: the same power, the same person. They know %2$s is you now.
message.jaymoskingdoms.identity.known.li: You lifted your mask (or lowered your hood) for the guard. %1$s knows %2$s is you now, and whatever %2$s did there is yours.
message.jaymoskingdoms.identity.known.re: Someone of %1$s got a good look at the face under your hood. They know %2$s is you now, and whatever %2$s did there is yours.
message.jaymoskingdoms.identity.known.wo: Word has spread to %1$s: they say %2$s is you.
message.jaymoskingdoms.identity.known.gu: A guard of %1$s took your mask off while you lay there. They know %2$s is you now, and whatever %2$s did there is yours.
message.jaymoskingdoms.identity.known.co: The mask was pulled off your body where the people of %1$s could see. They know %2$s was you, and whatever %2$s did there is yours.
message.jaymoskingdoms.identity.sent_off: The guards of %1$s won't have a masked stranger in their streets. Get out within %2$s seconds or unmask.
message.jaymoskingdoms.identity.exiled: The ruler of %s has no love for masked vigilantes. You are exiled: its guards will see you out of its streets.
message.jaymoskingdoms.identity.exiled.i: You are an exile in %1$s: they know who wears your costume. Leave within %2$s seconds or the guards will take you by force.
message.jaymoskingdoms.tier.unlocked: A harder world tier is open to you: %s. Take it from the skill screen (K), World Tier.
message.jaymoskingdoms.tier.wait: You can change your world tier again in %s seconds.
message.jaymoskingdoms.tier.party_road: Your party has been further down the road than you. Where they stand, you stand.
message.jaymoskingdoms.tier.below_floor: The world has grown too harsh for that: no one plays below %s now.
message.jaymoskingdoms.emigrants.ruin: The last peasants have left %s. With no one to rule, it falls into ruin.
message.jaymoskingdoms.reform.tyrant: Even the tyrant of %s blinks: with the people slipping away, taxes there are cut by %s%%.
message.jaymoskingdoms.reform.noble: The ruler of %s hears the empty houses: taxes are cut by %s%% and the guards told to go gently.
message.jaymoskingdoms.reform.warlord: The warlord of %s needs bodies for the levies: taxes are cut by %s%% to keep folk home.
message.jaymoskingdoms.reform.paranoid: Grudgingly, the ruler of %s eases off: taxes down %s%%, fewer searches at the gates.
message.jaymoskingdoms.reform.reveler: %s throws open its granaries to win its people back: taxes are cut by %s%%.
message.jaymoskingdoms.reform.purist: The proud ruler of %s softens: taxes down %s%%, and outsiders are to be treated fairly.
message.jaymoskingdoms.reform.stubborn.t: The tyrant of %s answers the leavers with a sneer. "Let them go."
message.jaymoskingdoms.reform.stubborn.n: The ruler of %s grieves the families leaving, but the treasury can spare nothing.
message.jaymoskingdoms.reform.stubborn.w: The warlord of %s calls the leavers deserters, and changes nothing.
message.jaymoskingdoms.reform.stubborn.p: The ruler of %s calls the leavers spies and traitors, and the gates stay watched.
message.jaymoskingdoms.reform.stubborn.r: In %s the feasting goes on, whoever packs up and leaves.
message.jaymoskingdoms.reform.stubborn.p: The ruler of %s says good riddance to those leaving: the realm is purer for it.
message.jaymoskingdoms.reform.tolerance: %s now forbids mocking folk for their blood. The realm needs every pair of hands it has.
message.jaymoskingdoms.hornkin_rally: %s roars, and the Hornkin rally to him!
message.jaymoskingdoms.warboss_horn: %s blows a war horn, and his piglins rally!
message.jaymoskingdoms.nether_host: A war host marches out of %s against %s.
message.jaymoskingdoms.nether_fort_falle: %s has fallen: %s is broken, and its host flees.
message.jaymoskingdoms.portal_raid: Hornkin from %s burst out of a Nether portal near %s, hunting for gold!
message.jaymoskingdoms.portal_raid_bough: %s pays the Hornkin in gold, and the raiders head back to their portal.
message.jaymoskingdoms.nightfall.beef: %s tears into the raw beef. The hunger leaves its eyes, for tonight.
message.jaymoskingdoms.nightfall.calling: %s turns the brewing stand over in pale hands. "An alchemist, then."
%s runs a finger down the smoker. "I know a thing or two about meat."
%s strokes the old shelf. "I have seen a great deal of history. I'll keep it."
%s taps out a slow tune on the note block. "A bard. Why not."
message.jaymoskingdoms.nightfall.sold.al: %s presses a warm, golden vial into your hand. "Drink it before they bite, not after."
message.jaymoskingdoms.nightfall.sold.sl: %s wraps a few strips of dark meat. "Better under a full moon."
message.jaymoskingdoms.nightfall.sold.ch: %s slides a card across. "It remembers how we move."
message.jaymoskingdoms.nightfall.sold.ba: %s hands over the lute. "Even the dead stop to listen."
message.jaymoskingdoms.nightfall.no_slee: Sleep won't come. Not while the night holds.
message.jaymoskingdoms.nightfall.begins: Something in your blood answers the dark. The sun will not rise.
message.jaymoskingdoms.nightfall.paralys: You can't move. Something is in the room.
message.jaymoskingdoms.bounty.stale: The notice is out of date. You tear it down.
message.jaymoskingdoms.bounty.stale_noti: That bounty is over. No one will pin this notice up again.
message.jaymoskingdoms.bounty.not_here: This notice is for another realm's board.
message.jaymoskingdoms.bounty.gave_up: You pin the notice back up and give up the hunt for %s.
message.jaymoskingdoms.bounty.posted: %s has put a price on %s's head: %s.
message.jaymoskingdoms.bounty.taken: Someone else is already on this one.
message.jaymoskingdoms.bounty.full: You can hunt only %s bounties at once.
message.jaymoskingdoms.bounty.took: You took the bounty on %s (%s). Bring them in alive, or their head for half.
message.jaymoskingdoms.bounty.sentenced: You were brought before the court of %s. Your crimes there are paid for (a fine of %s).
message.jaymoskingdoms.crook.picked_seen: %s picked your pocket (%s), and was seen! Catch them or confront them.
message.jaymoskingdoms.crook.picked_felt: You feel a hand in your pocket: %s just lifted %s! Confront them, or bring them down.
message.jaymoskingdoms.crook.missed: Your pack feels lighter. Someone lifted %s from you.
message.jaymoskingdoms.crook.recovered: You take back what was stolen from you: %s.
message.jaymoskingdoms.dragon.crashed: %s crashes to the ground, wounded and wary. Come close crouching, with empty hands, and it may come to trust you.
message.jaymoskingdoms.dragon.bolted: %s has had enough. It bolts into the sky.
message.jaymoskingdoms.dragon.tamed: %s lowers its head and lets you touch its snout. It's yours.
message.jaymoskingdoms.dragon.exhausted: %s is exhausted and can only glide down. Let it rest, or feed it meat.
message.jaymoskingdoms.dragon.not_yours: %s won't carry you unless its owner is in the saddle.
message.jaymoskingdoms.aeolus.phase3: Aeolus breathes all four winds at once.
message.jaymoskingdoms.aeolus.gale: The sky draws breath. Get low!
message.jaymoskingdoms.aeolus.fallen: Aeolus falls. The winds are calm, and four eggs lie where he fell.
message.jaymoskingdoms.stake.tied: Line tied. Now string it to the next stake, straight along the ground (at most %s blocks).
message.jaymoskingdoms.bent.cold: Cold, it just rings off the anvil. Melt it down or heat it in a forge first.
message.jaymoskingdoms.stake.strung: Strung: a side of %s blocks, stake to stake.
message.jaymoskingdoms.stake.not_straigh: A line runs straight north-south or east-west, from stake to stake.
message.jaymoskingdoms.stake.too_far: The string won't stretch that far: %s blocks at most.
message.jaymoskingdoms.stake.too_steep: Those stakes are too far apart in height to string together.
message.jaymoskingdoms.stake.already: Those stakes are already strung together.
message.jaymoskingdoms.stake.full: That stake can't hold another line.
message.jaymoskingdoms.pulley.wound: The rope is wound all the way in.
message.jaymoskingdoms.pulley.full: The pulley can't hold any more rope.
message.jaymoskingdoms.pulley.no_rope: No rope left on the pulley: give it some.
message.jaymoskingdoms.king_rallies.her: %s rallies! Her guards rush to her side.
message.jaymoskingdoms.king_fallen.her: The Queen of %s has fallen to %s!
message.jaymoskingdoms.lord_fallen.her: The Lady of %s has fallen to %s!
message.jaymoskingdoms.old_age.king.her: The Queen of %s has died peacefully in her sleep, at a great age. Her heir will take the throne by tomorrow.
message.jaymoskingdoms.old_age.lord.her: The Lady of %s has died peacefully in her sleep, at a great age. Her heir will take the seat by tomorrow.
message.jaymoskingdoms.fate.successor.he: %s mourns its queen. An heir will take the throne by tomorrow.
message.jaymoskingdoms.fate.successor_lo: %s mourns its lady. Another will take her seat by tomorrow.
message.jaymoskingdoms.succession.her: A new queen takes the throne of %s.
message.jaymoskingdoms.succession.lord.h: A new lady takes the seat of %s.
message.jaymoskingdoms.carriage.bought.h: %s has bought its queen a carriage.
Your mouth is dry. You can hear the heartbeats in the next room.
The fever's in your veins now. Every neck looks soft.
You're burning. If you don't feed, it will feed for you.
The blood takes you. Your legs are moving before you are.
A pulse, close by. Nothing else in the world matters.
Your teeth ache. Your body turns toward the warmth on its own.
The thirst has the reins. You're only along for the ride.
message.jaymoskingdoms.blood_fever.give_: You stop fighting. It feels like coming home.
Why fight it? You were made for this.
You let go. The red rushes in.
You tear yourself back. Your hands won't stop shaking.
Not tonight. Not them. You stagger away, sick and starving.
You win, for now. The thirst sulks somewhere behind your eyes.
message.jaymoskingdoms.blood_fever.fed.g: The fever breaks. You've never felt so alive, or so far from yourself.
message.jaymoskingdoms.blood_fever.fed.t: You come back to yourself with blood on your chin. You didn't choose this. Did you?
message.jaymoskingdoms.blood_fever.stage: The thirst comes quicker now. It knows your name.
Bloodbound. The night bends to you, and you bend to the blood.
Ravenous. Even your friends smell like supper.
There's nothing left of you to fight with. Only the blood.
You feel more like yourself. The thirst is quieter.
The blood loosens its grip. A little of you comes back.
Your friends smell like friends again. Mostly.
Somewhere under the hunger, you're still there.
message.jaymoskingdoms.blood_request.sun: Stay out of the sun today.
message.jaymoskingdoms.blood_request.kep: The blood is pleased with you.
message.jaymoskingdoms.blood_request.bro: The blood remembers what you ignored.
message.jaymoskingdoms.sleeping_prey.wok: You slept badly. Your neck aches.
You slept badly, and you can't say why.
message.jaymoskingdoms.thrall.bound: Something in you leans toward them, and you don't mind.
message.jaymoskingdoms.mask.up: You hold still. The pallor settles; you could pass for anyone.
message.jaymoskingdoms.flinch.held_out: Their eyes narrow. It isn't enough.
message.jaymoskingdoms.flinch.self: You recoil before you can stop yourself.
message.jaymoskingdoms.flinch.held_out_s: You grit your teeth and hold your ground.
message.jaymoskingdoms.audience.ask: [Ask to be taken before the ruler]
message.jaymoskingdoms.audience.no_guard: There's no guard near enough to ask.
message.jaymoskingdoms.pigeon.nobody: Your pigeon cocks its head. It knows nobody called %s.
message.jaymoskingdoms.pigeon.self: Your pigeon won't fly a letter to you.
message.jaymoskingdoms.whaler.fitting: The whaler %s fits out at %s's harbour. Come aboard before she sails to sign on for a share.
message.jaymoskingdoms.whaler.signed: You sign on with %s as a %s, for a share of the catch. Ask the captain about work to change berth before she sails. Be aboard when she comes home.
message.jaymoskingdoms.whaler.sails: Cast off! We sail for the whaling ground.
message.jaymoskingdoms.whaler.anchor: Let go the anchor! Lash her alongside, and get the spades into her. Light the tryworks!
message.jaymoskingdoms.whaler.lay: Your lay: %s silver and two bottles of oil from %s, as her %s.
message.jaymoskingdoms.whaler.home: The whaler %s is home with %s whales and %s bottles of oil.
message.jaymoskingdoms.whaler.further: The nearer grounds are fished out. %s's next whaler will sail further out to open ocean, where the whales are fatter and the seas less kind.
message.jaymoskingdoms.whaler.never_home: %s's whaler never came home. Her grounds were too far out, and the sea kept her.
message.jaymoskingdoms.whaler.sails_far: Cast off! The near grounds are fished out. We sail %s blocks out, to open ocean.
message.jaymoskingdoms.whaler.pirates: Sail ho! Black flag! All hands, stand by to run!
message.jaymoskingdoms.whaler.pirates_si: Pirates! A rover, %2$s, has sighted %1$s out on the far grounds.
message.jaymoskingdoms.whaler.sharks: Fins in the water! Sharks are circling the boats.
message.jaymoskingdoms.whale_cut_in: Too big to cut from the water: lash it alongside a big ship to cut in the rest
message.jaymoskingdoms.underworld.found: You've found %s's back room. Keep it quiet.
message.jaymoskingdoms.bust.sentence: Caught by %s's guard for %s: you're sentenced to %s.
message.jaymoskingdoms.bust.seen: %s is caught by %s's guard and sentenced to %s.
message.jaymoskingdoms.bust.cells: You're thrown in the cells for %s minutes. Dig out and you're an outlaw.
message.jaymoskingdoms.bust.released: Your time is served. %s's guards let you out.
message.jaymoskingdoms.bust.escaped: You've broken out of %s's cells. Every guard there wants you now.
message.jaymoskingdoms.mana.unattuned: You aren't attuned: you feel no mana in you.
message.jaymoskingdoms.mana.attuned: The amethyst sings, and something answers in you. You are attuned: you feel mana, and you can learn spells from scrolls and cast them with a staff.
message.jaymoskingdoms.mana.attuned.natu: Mana floods through you. You are attuned, as every caster is.
message.jaymoskingdoms.restoration.hungr: You're too hungry to cast that.
message.jaymoskingdoms.restoration.downe: Mending can't reach the downed: Rekindle them (sneak and J).
message.jaymoskingdoms.hard.chains.hold: The shackle brings you up short.
message.jaymoskingdoms.hard.chains.slipp: You slip the shackle in the dark.
message.jaymoskingdoms.hard.chains.no_pi: Hold a lockpick to try the shackle.
message.jaymoskingdoms.hard.chains.hunte: The camp will know you are gone. Its raiders hunt you until the day is out.
message.jaymoskingdoms.hard.cell.locked: The door is locked. Hold a lockpick to try it, or hold silver to pay the fine of %s.
message.jaymoskingdoms.hard.cell.short: The fine is %s silver, and you do not have it.
message.jaymoskingdoms.hard.cell.paid: You pay the fine of %s silver, and the jailer lets you out.
message.jaymoskingdoms.hard.cell.picked: The door gives. You slip out of the cells of %s, and it will want you back.
message.jaymoskingdoms.hard.evict.warn: Move along. No sleeping rough in these streets.
message.jaymoskingdoms.hard.evict.take: I warned you. You will spend the night in the cells.
message.jaymoskingdoms.hard.evict.warned: The watch of %s has warned you to move along.
message.jaymoskingdoms.hard.evict.jailed: The watch of %s takes you in for the night. Wait for dawn, or hold silver at the door to pay the fine.
message.jaymoskingdoms.hard.evict.settle: With work or a bed of your own in %s, the watch leaves you be.
message.jaymoskingdoms.hard.cast.ended: Your own kind will hear you out again.
message.jaymoskingdoms.job.hired: %s takes you on: you're its %s now.
message.jaymoskingdoms.job.gone: %s is no more, and your work as a %s with it.
message.jaymoskingdoms.job.fired.reputat: %s has had enough of you. You've lost your work there.
message.jaymoskingdoms.job.fired.harm: You struck one of %s's own. You've lost your work there.
message.jaymoskingdoms.job.disliked: %s won't hire someone it thinks so little of.
message.jaymoskingdoms.job.paid: Your wages: %s from %s for the day's work as a %s (%s orders).
message.jaymoskingdoms.job.paid_short: Your wages: %s from %s for the day's work as a %s (%s orders). Its storehouse was short.
message.jaymoskingdoms.job.quit: You've given up your work as a %s with %s.
message.jaymoskingdoms.job.apprentice: %s is your apprentice now. Each day they'll bring the storehouse goods of their %s's trade and earn you a cut.
message.jaymoskingdoms.job.stall_opened: Your stall in %s is open. Leave your goods in it: villagers buy up to %s worth a day, from noon.
message.jaymoskingdoms.job.stall_refused: That can't be your stall: it must be in %s, and not its storehouse.
message.jaymoskingdoms.job.none: You have no job. Ask a villager about work, or pull a Help wanted notice off a bounty board.
message.jaymoskingdoms.info.sovereign: Its crown is worn by %s. The ruler on its throne is their steward.
message.jaymoskingdoms.crown.abdicated: %s has given up the crown of %s. Its steward now rules in their own right.
message.jaymoskingdoms.crown.steward_fel: The steward of %s has fallen. %s keeps the crown, and a new steward will sit on the throne by tomorrow.
message.jaymoskingdoms.crown.new_steward: %s takes the throne of %s as steward.
message.jaymoskingdoms.crown.usurped: %s has slain their ruler in the hall and seized the crown of %s!
message.jaymoskingdoms.crown.inherited: %s, the late ruler's spouse, inherits the crown of %s.
message.jaymoskingdoms.crown.fell_in_war: %s, sovereign of %s, has fallen in battle to %s.
message.jaymoskingdoms.crown.conquered: %s has claimed the crown of conquered %s.
message.jaymoskingdoms.crown.founded: %s has founded the realm of %s and wears its crown.
message.jaymoskingdoms.crown.yours: The crown of %s is yours. A villager steward keeps the throne while you're away. /kingdom crown abdicate gives it up.
message.jaymoskingdoms.crown.may_claim: You may claim the crown of %s by tomorrow.
message.jaymoskingdoms.crown.no_claim: You have no claim to that crown, or it has lapsed.
message.jaymoskingdoms.crown.roads: You wear no crown. As a lord, slay your ruler in their own hall; marry a ruler and outlive them; as a lord at war, take an enemy's seat or slay its ruler, then claim it; or found a realm with /kingdom crown found [name] (%s silver).
message.jaymoskingdoms.crown.overworld: Realms are only founded in the Overworld.
message.jaymoskingdoms.crown.too_near: This land is too near %s. Found your realm at least %s blocks from any other.
message.jaymoskingdoms.crown.found_cost: Founding a realm takes %s silver. You have %s.
message.jaymoskingdoms.death.too_many: You can hold no more than %s of the dead at once.
message.jaymoskingdoms.death.whispers_si: The dead keep their silence. Whatever happened here, it was too long ago.
message.jaymoskingdoms.death.door_open: Death's Door stands open behind you.
message.jaymoskingdoms.death.door_used: Death turns you away at the door. You're back on your feet, but something stayed behind. Sleep to win it back.
message.jaymoskingdoms.blood.too_little: Too little blood left in you to cast that.
message.jaymoskingdoms.blood.too_deep: You cast too deep: a wound opens on you.
message.jaymoskingdoms.mana.attuned.vis: The essences you carry have worn a channel through you, and mana runs in it now. You are attuned: you can learn spells from scrolls and cast them with a staff.
message.jaymoskingdoms.mana.burnt_out: You're burnt out: no magic will come until it passes.
message.jaymoskingdoms.mana.smothered: Something near you smothers your magic: it costs you more.
message.jaymoskingdoms.mana.brimming: You're brimming: the amethyst has nowhere to go.
message.jaymoskingdoms.mana.sick.1: Your head swims with the magic you've pushed through it. Mana will come back slowly for a while.
message.jaymoskingdoms.mana.sick.2: Mana sickness: you've cast too hard, too fast. You're weak and slow, no mana comes back, and every spell costs more until it passes.
message.jaymoskingdoms.mana.sick.3: You burn out. What mana you had burns out of you, and no magic will come until you've recovered.
message.jaymoskingdoms.magic.tier.1: Magic? A spark of it. Enough to feel, not much more.
message.jaymoskingdoms.magic.tier.2: I have a steady little flame of it. It does what I ask, mostly.
message.jaymoskingdoms.magic.tier.3: A fair measure. Most who work magic would call me their equal.
message.jaymoskingdoms.magic.tier.4: More than most. It burns bright in me, and I've learned to hold it.
message.jaymoskingdoms.magic.tier.5: Few in this world carry what I carry. Mind how you go near me.
message.jaymoskingdoms.magic.compare.eve: You'll have seen as much in my glow. We're about even, you and I.
message.jaymoskingdoms.magic.compare.str: Though I see yours burns brighter than mine.
message.jaymoskingdoms.magic.compare.wea: Yours is a dimmer light than mine, but lights grow.
message.jaymoskingdoms.magic.corrupted: And you... you see it, don't you? Not as the attuned do. Something in you has gone wrong.
message.jaymoskingdoms.magic.blind: You can't see it, can you? Only the attuned see the glow.
message.jaymoskingdoms.wand.unattuned: The wand is dead in your hand: you aren't attuned.
message.jaymoskingdoms.wand.full: The wand can hold no more.
message.jaymoskingdoms.wand.nothing: You have no mana to pour.
message.jaymoskingdoms.wand.poured: Poured %s mana into the wand (%s of %s)
message.jaymoskingdoms.wand.empty: The wand is empty. Sneak and use it to pour mana in.
message.jaymoskingdoms.whaler.paid_off: %1$s's crew are paid off: %2$s sign on for her next voyage, %3$s go ashore with their pay.
message.jaymoskingdoms.absorb_hurt: Hurt, you lose your hold on it.
message.jaymoskingdoms.bio.absorbed: Absorbed. %s more worth to your next form.
message.jaymoskingdoms.bio.absorbed_last: Absorbed. Nothing left to grow into.
message.jaymoskingdoms.bio.regrown: Borrowed blood knits a lost limb back together.
message.jaymoskingdoms.bio.form.1: Your body splits and remakes itself: Semi-Perfect. You stand taller, heavier, the tail shorter and thicker.
message.jaymoskingdoms.bio.form.2: Your body remakes itself one last time: Perfect. Steady, sleek, the strongest you will be. You could bud copies of yourself now (the heritage key, on no one).
message.jaymoskingdoms.bio.bud_locked: You aren't grown enough to bud.
message.jaymoskingdoms.bio.bud_wait: Your body is still knitting: %s seconds.
message.jaymoskingdoms.bio.bud_weak: Too weak or too hungry to bud.
message.jaymoskingdoms.bio.bud_empty: Nothing stored to bud with: absorb a foe first.
message.jaymoskingdoms.larder: %s: %s food in store (wants %s), meals at %s%% of the usual price, %s eateries, %s cooks, %s visitors in town
message.jaymoskingdoms.order_wary: %s won't take orders from you until it trusts you (trust %s).
message.jaymoskingdoms.no_home: %s has no home yet. Set one from the command wheel.
message.jaymoskingdoms.roster_lost: Your horse couldn't be found where it was last seen.
message.jaymoskingdoms.accuse.deaf: The priest turns away. They will not hear you today.
message.jaymoskingdoms.accuse.nobody: There is no one near enough to accuse.
message.jaymoskingdoms.accuse.right: The holy water burns %1$s. The priest cries it out to all the realm.
message.jaymoskingdoms.accuse.burned: The holy water burns. The priest cries your shame to the realm.
message.jaymoskingdoms.accuse.wrong: The water only wets %1$s. The priest does not forgive a false word.
message.jaymoskingdoms.accuse.splashed: A priest splashes you with holy water. It is only water, but someone accused you.
message.jaymoskingdoms.will.roared: %s's roar shakes you to the bone!
message.jaymoskingdoms.will_clash.warn: %s is staring you down. Hold your ground!
message.jaymoskingdoms.will_clash.begin: You lock eyes with %s. Press jump to hold your ground!
message.jaymoskingdoms.will_clash.lost: You couldn't hold the stare of %s. Your knees shake.
message.jaymoskingdoms.stare.overboard: %s goes over the side under your stare.
message.jaymoskingdoms.stare.kneels: %s throws down their arms and kneels. Take them in.
message.jaymoskingdoms.stare.captain: %s jumps ship, and %s has no hand at her helm!
message.jaymoskingdoms.stare.tribute: %s won't meet your eyes, and pays you %s silver from the treasury of %s to be gone.
message.jaymoskingdoms.stare.yielded: The ruler of %2$s could not meet the stare of %1$s, and gave up the crown!
message.jaymoskingdoms.valor.named_once: Your Valor already has its name: %s.
message.jaymoskingdoms.valor.name_length: A Valor's name is 1 to 32 letters.
message.jaymoskingdoms.valor.spent: Your Valor is spent. Your hands shake.
message.jaymoskingdoms.valor.unbound: Your Valor won't answer. Ki and magic leave it nothing to hold on to.
message.jaymoskingdoms.valor.kings_close: King's Valor comes only from felling great foes.
message.jaymoskingdoms.valor.kings_pool: Your Valor runs too low for King's Valor.
message.jaymoskingdoms.journal.given: A small book has come into your things. Someone has stitched a ladder on its cover.
message.jaymoskingdoms.deed.forged: The iron rings differently under your hands.
message.jaymoskingdoms.deed.aether_troph: The thing in your pack is warm, and it is not from here.
message.jaymoskingdoms.deed.pod_flight: The ground holds you again. It remembers the way back.
message.jaymoskingdoms.deed.maw_salvage: Dust on your hands that no water will take.
message.jaymoskingdoms.knowledge.risen.1: Knowledge 1: anvils ring for you now, and bog iron holds together.
message.jaymoskingdoms.knowledge.risen.2: Knowledge 2: the smithing table, and the heavy arms.
message.jaymoskingdoms.knowledge.risen.3: Knowledge 3: the enchanting table wakes for you.
message.jaymoskingdoms.knowledge.risen.4: Knowledge 4: the higher spells and techniques.
message.jaymoskingdoms.knowledge.risen.5: Knowledge 5: the End's frames will take your eyes.
The anvil won't ring for you yet. (Knowledge 1: the Goblin King)
You don't know this table's work yet. (Knowledge 2: an Ogre King)
The table's book stays shut to you. (Knowledge 3: the Skeleton Lord)
It slips out of your grasp. (Knowledge 4: the Piglin King)
The frame won't take the eye. (Knowledge 5: the Wither)
Heavy arms are past you yet. (Knowledge 2: an Ogre King)
message.jaymoskingdoms.job.no_yard: %1$s has no landing yard, so no work for a %2$s.
message.jaymoskingdoms.job.fare: A fare of %s for the trip.
message.jaymoskingdoms.job.find: A first find: %s from the prospecting fund.
message.jaymoskingdoms.job.ferried: Your parcel is handed over at %s's landing yard.
message.jaymoskingdoms.form.first: You learn %s. The Five-Art Belt and the Battle Stance are yours.
message.jaymoskingdoms.form.stance_off: You ease out of your stance.
message.jaymoskingdoms.form.bare: Nothing is on that slot of your belt.
message.jaymoskingdoms.form.weapon: %s wants a different weapon in hand.
message.jaymoskingdoms.form.masterstroke: A masterstroke needs a fallen foe before you.
message.jaymoskingdoms.form.sealed: The Eight Signs bind your forms.
message.jaymoskingdoms.form.armless: With both arms broken you can't do a form.
message.jaymoskingdoms.form.mounted: The lance is couched from the saddle: mount up first.
message.jaymoskingdoms.form.pinned: Pinned! Press again to tug the spear back.
message.jaymoskingdoms.form.hungry: You are too hungry to put that behind a blow.
message.jaymoskingdoms.form.belt_away: Change your belt beside a training post or a dummy.
message.jaymoskingdoms.form.figure_eight: Figure Eight. Press again to stop.
message.jaymoskingdoms.form.falling_fist: Falling Fist needs a fall of three blocks or more.
message.jaymoskingdoms.form.marked_quarr: Marked: %s. Press again to strike from behind.
Your quarry is too far to dash to.
There is no room behind your quarry.
You have no bolas to throw.
message.jaymoskingdoms.moon_curse.cursed: The moon has found you. You can feel it deciding.
message.jaymoskingdoms.moon_curse.feral: The red moon is in your teeth.
message.jaymoskingdoms.moon_curse.cured: The moon loosens its grip, and you are only tired.
message.jaymoskingdoms.flaw.light_sleepe: Something stirs nearby and wakes you.
message.jaymoskingdoms.truce_token.unsee: None of the tribe can see you raise it.
message.jaymoskingdoms.bog_iron.crumbles: It crumbles to rust in your hands.
message.jaymoskingdoms.crippled_leg: Something in your leg gives way.
message.jaymoskingdoms.trial.won: You've passed the trial. The tribe will let you be for a while, and the king sends a gift.
message.jaymoskingdoms.trial.beaten: You're beaten, and they let you go.
message.jaymoskingdoms.trial.fled: You walked away from the trial.
message.jaymoskingdoms.trial.time: The trial's over. You took too long.
message.jaymoskingdoms.trial.weapon: A weapon in a brawl! The ogres jeer you out.
message.jaymoskingdoms.captain.sworn_fal: %s is dead. The oath he swore dies with him.
message.jaymoskingdoms.captain.challenge: You already have a challenge nailed up.
message.jaymoskingdoms.clash.militia: The militia of %1$s are marching on %2$s!
message.jaymoskingdoms.clash.driven_off: The party from %1$s has been cut down at %2$s.
message.jaymoskingdoms.crook.wrongly_acc: %s had nothing to do with it, and won't soon forget being called a thief.
message.jaymoskingdoms.cot.brewing: The brewing stand's herbs ease you: your bones are set and your wounds mended.
message.jaymoskingdoms.shrine.answered: A calm warmth settles over you.
message.jaymoskingdoms.shrine.quiet: The candles are quiet. You have prayed today.
message.jaymoskingdoms.grue.no_answer: Your spirit does not answer you.
message.jaymoskingdoms.grue.mute: Your mouth does not move. (/ooc still works.)
message.jaymoskingdoms.grue.not_down: It will not let them go standing. Bring them down first.
message.jaymoskingdoms.grue.exorcised: The draught burns the darkness out of %s.
message.jaymoskingdoms.grue.freed: Your hands are your own again. Your spirit is gone.
message.jaymoskingdoms.grue.subjugated: The Grue is bound. Its power answers to you now.
message.jaymoskingdoms.horde.orc.2: Word from the wilds: the war camp of %s has grown into a warhold. A second stockade rises round it, a stretch of it every day.
message.jaymoskingdoms.horde.orc.3: Word from the wilds: the warhold of %s has grown into a horde town, its walls pushed out again and its fires beyond counting.
message.jaymoskingdoms.horde.orc.4: The orcs of %1$s have raised a horde kingdom. %2$s takes the title of Warlord, and %3$s orc camps about it bow to him.
message.jaymoskingdoms.horde.goblin.2: Word from the wilds: the goblin village of %s has grown into a warren. A new palisade creeps out round it, a stretch of it every day.
message.jaymoskingdoms.horde.goblin.3: Word from the wilds: the warren of %s has grown into a goblin town, all mushroom roofs and smoke as far as the walls.
message.jaymoskingdoms.horde.goblin.4: The goblins of %1$s have raised a goblin kingdom. %2$s takes the crown as Goblin King, and %3$s goblin villages about it bow to him.
message.jaymoskingdoms.locks.fitted: Lock fitted. Its key is in your pack.
message.jaymoskingdoms.locks.refitted: Lock fitted. It still answers to key %s.
message.jaymoskingdoms.locks.already: There's a lock on it already.
message.jaymoskingdoms.locks.storehouse: The realm keeps its own locks on its stores.
message.jaymoskingdoms.locks.wrong_key: That key doesn't fit this lock.
message.jaymoskingdoms.locks.no_key.pin: Locked: a %s pin lock. You'll need its key, or a lockpick.
message.jaymoskingdoms.locks.no_key.rota: Locked: a %s rotary lock. You'll need its key, or a lockpick.
message.jaymoskingdoms.locks.slow: It's locked and banded with iron: breaking it will take a while.
message.jaymoskingdoms.currency: %s trades in %s. Going rates (emeralds a coin):%s
message.jaymoskingdoms.currency_none: No settlement near enough to have a coin.
message.jaymoskingdoms.caravan.robbed.gr: You broke open a cart of %s. They will not forget it.
message.jaymoskingdoms.codex.given: Something to keep what you find in. Its pages are blank, for now.
message.jaymoskingdoms.codex.full: The codex has no room for another.
message.jaymoskingdoms.codex.double: The codex already holds %s of these.
message.jaymoskingdoms.kit.cooldown: %s is not ready for %s more seconds
message.jaymoskingdoms.kit.held: %s is done by holding left mouse
message.jaymoskingdoms.kit.nothing: There is nothing there for it
message.jaymoskingdoms.kit.too_weak: You have too little life left to strike that bargain
message.jaymoskingdoms.town.village.2: %1$s has outgrown its fields: a palisade will rise round it, a stretch of it every day.
message.jaymoskingdoms.town.village.3: The folk of %1$s have grown their village into a walled town, its gates cut and its roads laid out beyond them.
message.jaymoskingdoms.town.village.4: %1$s is now a fortified town, its walls pushed out again and its gates held by iron golems.
message.jaymoskingdoms.town.blossom.2: %1$s has outgrown its ring of minka: a fence of timber and plaster will rise round it, a stretch of it every day.
message.jaymoskingdoms.town.blossom.3: The folk of %1$s have raised a walled blossom town, white plaster under dark tile all the way round.
message.jaymoskingdoms.town.blossom.4: %1$s has become a castle town, its walls pushed out again round shrine and market alike.
message.jaymoskingdoms.raid.looted: The raiders of %s carried off %s items and coins. Cut the carriers down to take it back.
message.jaymoskingdoms.raid.announce.ogr: The ground shakes! %s leads his ogres down on %s!
message.jaymoskingdoms.raid.arrive.ogre: The ogres are at the gates of %s, smashing for loot!
message.jaymoskingdoms.raid.ogre.beaten: The ogre raid is beaten off.
message.jaymoskingdoms.raid.ogre.withdra: The ogres lumber home with their plunder.
message.jaymoskingdoms.raid.ogre.looted: The ogres carried off %s items and coins. Cut the carriers down to take it back.
message.jaymoskingdoms.pirate.prize: The pirates of %s took the cargo of %s!
message.jaymoskingdoms.warpath.orc: War drums from %1$s: its Warlord takes the whole horde on the warpath against %2$s.
message.jaymoskingdoms.warpath.goblin: Horns from %1$s: its Goblin King sends every goblin he has against %2$s.
message.jaymoskingdoms.warpath.sworn: Your horde marches on %1$s (near %2$s, %3$s). Join the host there.
message.jaymoskingdoms.horde_tribute: %1$s pays tribute to %2$s rather than face its horde.
message.jaymoskingdoms.horde_tribute.sto: %1$s can no longer pay %2$s its tribute. The horde will come for it.
message.jaymoskingdoms.horde_oath.sworn: %1$s has sworn to the horde of %2$s.
message.jaymoskingdoms.horde_oath.unprov: The horde of %s won't take your oath: earn the tribe's favour first, or be one of their own.
message.jaymoskingdoms.horde_oath.left: You forswear the horde of %s. They won't forget it.
message.jaymoskingdoms.shrine.theirs_onl: %s takes offerings only from those sworn to them.
message.jaymoskingdoms.shrine.offered_to: You have made an offering today.
message.jaymoskingdoms.boon.waiting: Your patron is silent for now.
message.jaymoskingdoms.shrine.turning: %1$s hears you, and %2$s sees it. (%3$s of %4$s days)
message.jaymoskingdoms.shrine.turned: You are sworn to %1$s. %2$s marks you.
message.jaymoskingdoms.trial.over: %s's omens leave you. The scar stays.
message.jaymoskingdoms.rite.done: The rite is done. %s's omens grow dim.
message.jaymoskingdoms.holy.rivals: %1$s (%2$s) and %3$s (%4$s) cannot share the world: their faiths are at odds.
message.jaymoskingdoms.holy_war.begun: A HOLY WAR! %1$s, for %2$s, against %3$s, for %4$s. The faithful will take sides.
message.jaymoskingdoms.patron_champion.u: It does not stir for you. (World tier Wildlands and up)
message.jaymoskingdoms.patron_champion.n: Its weapon breaks as it falls. It will hold by your third try. (%1$s of %2$s)
message.jaymoskingdoms.patron_champion.h: %s's champion loses your trail. It will come again.
message.jaymoskingdoms.treaty.signed.rec: %s and %s have recognised each other's crowns.
message.jaymoskingdoms.treaty.signed.pas: %s and %s have granted each other's people safe passage.
message.jaymoskingdoms.treaty.signed.cha: %s and %s have signed a trade charter.
message.jaymoskingdoms.treaty.signed.aid: %s and %s have sworn a treaty of aid: if either goes to war, the other goes with it.
message.jaymoskingdoms.treaty.great.reco: %s and %s have recognised each other's crowns.
message.jaymoskingdoms.treaty.great.pass: %s and %s have granted each other's people safe passage.
message.jaymoskingdoms.treaty.great.char: %s and %s have signed a great trade charter.
message.jaymoskingdoms.treaty.great.aid: %s and %s have sworn a treaty of aid: if either goes to war, the other goes with it.
message.jaymoskingdoms.treaty.great_brok: %1$s has broken faith with %3$s and torn up %2$s.
message.jaymoskingdoms.treaty.great_war: %s marches on %s and tears up every treaty between them.
message.jaymoskingdoms.treaty.great_aid: Bound by their treaty of aid, %s goes to war at %s's side against %s.
message.jaymoskingdoms.treaty.aid_coin: %s cannot march with %s, but sends %s from its treasury for the war against %s.
message.jaymoskingdoms.treaty.aid_torn: %s is bound by treaties to both %s and %s, and stands aside.
message.jaymoskingdoms.treaty.aid_called: %s is at war with %s. By your treaty of aid, %s stands at its side.
message.jaymoskingdoms.envoy.waiting: An envoy of %s waits in your hall at %s with an offer: %s. They will wait %s days.
message.jaymoskingdoms.envoy.unanswered: The envoy of %s has gone home unanswered.
message.jaymoskingdoms.envoy.sent_signed: Your envoy writes from %s: they have signed %s.
message.jaymoskingdoms.envoy.sent_refuse: Your envoy writes from %s: they will not sign %s. %s
message.jaymoskingdoms.envoy.reason.tens: Too much bad blood lies between your realms.
message.jaymoskingdoms.envoy.reason.cree: Their creed sits ill with yours.
message.jaymoskingdoms.envoy.reason.temp: Their ruler trusts no one's word.
message.jaymoskingdoms.envoy.reason.stan: They think little of your name.
message.jaymoskingdoms.envoy.reason.unre: They do not yet recognise your crown.
message.jaymoskingdoms.envoy.slain: An envoy of %s was slain on the road.
message.jaymoskingdoms.election.elected: The guilds of %2$s have chosen %1$s to rule.
message.jaymoskingdoms.election.acclaime: At the moot of %2$s, %1$s is acclaimed ruler.
message.jaymoskingdoms.election.player: The notables of %2$s have chosen %1$s to wear its crown.
message.jaymoskingdoms.election.you: The notables of %s have chosen you to wear its crown. %s, its steward, rules in your name while you're away.
message.jaymoskingdoms.regency.begun: %1$s of %2$s is too young to rule; %3$s will govern as regent until they come of age.
message.jaymoskingdoms.regency.of_age_la: %1$s has come of age and takes the throne of %2$s.
message.jaymoskingdoms.regency.of_age: %1$s has come of age and takes the throne of %2$s from the regent %3$s.
message.jaymoskingdoms.regency.ward_died: %1$s, the young heir of %2$s, is dead; the regent %3$s now rules in their own right.
message.jaymoskingdoms.fate.successor.el: %s mourns its king. A successor will be chosen by tomorrow.
%s mourns its queen. A successor will be chosen by tomorrow.
message.jaymoskingdoms.fate.successor_lo: %s mourns its lord. Another will be chosen for his seat by tomorrow.
%s mourns its lady. Another will be chosen for her seat by tomorrow.
message.jaymoskingdoms.old_age.king.elec: The King of %s has died peacefully in his sleep, at a great age. A successor will be chosen by tomorrow.
The Queen of %s has died peacefully in her sleep, at a great age. A successor will be chosen by tomorrow.
message.jaymoskingdoms.old_age.lord.elec: The Lord of %s has died peacefully in his sleep, at a great age. Another will be chosen for his seat by tomorrow.
The Lady of %s has died peacefully in her sleep, at a great age. Another will be chosen for her seat by tomorrow.

message.jaymoskingdoms.rpg_gate.unlearne: You haven't learned this yet: find it on your skill web, or ask a trainer
message.jaymoskingdoms.aetherion.catacly: Aetherion rears up, and the stars begin to fall.
message.jaymoskingdoms.dragon.crashed_wa: %s sinks onto its belly, wounded and wary. Come close crouching, with empty hands, and it may come to trust you.
message.jaymoskingdoms.dragon.bolted_wal: %s has had enough. It turns and lumbers off.
message.jaymoskingdoms.hollow.turned.ent: Its voice is still in your head. You hunger for the dark, and for it.
message.jaymoskingdoms.hollow.turned.rea: Something tore your soul loose and put it back crooked.
message.jaymoskingdoms.hollow.turned.hex: The witch's brew is in your blood. Your skin has gone green and cold.
message.jaymoskingdoms.hollow.turned.zom: The bite took. You're hungry, and not for bread.
message.jaymoskingdoms.hollow.turned.ske: You feel light. Too light. There's very little left of you to feel.
message.jaymoskingdoms.hollow.turned.wra: The cold went in and never came out. Your edges blur.
message.jaymoskingdoms.hollow.turned.pal: The dead took you with them, a little way. You came back grey.
